info.name: TwinTrack Accounts API
info.description: Every route of the Master API, with tests. Run it in Postman against a running API, or with `npm run test:postman`, which starts its own copy. Update this file in the same change as any route.

item.name: Sign in as a super admin for Accounts
Give the Finance Lead the finance approver profile
Sign in as the finance approver
Set a default currency that is not listed (refused)
Reveal an account's bank number (none set)

exec: pm.test('returns 200 with the number, or 404 when the account has none', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 404]));

item.name: Save a journal voucher as a draft
Reverse a voucher that is not recorded (refused)
Save a payment voucher as a draft
Save a receipt voucher as a draft
Edit a draft receipt voucher without a reason (refused)
Set how a client is billed
Save a bill as a draft
Pay a bill that is not recorded (refused)
Approve the bill as the finance approver
Save an invoice as a draft
Receive payment for an invoice not issued (refused)
Make a payroll run for a month
Change a draft run pay date
Pay a run that is not recorded (refused)
Approve the payroll run as the finance approver
Read a fixed asset and its schedule
Read the general ledger for cash
Export profit and loss as CSV
Load a bank statement from CSV
Match a line to an entry not on the account (refused)
Unmatch a line that is not matched (refused)
Complete with lines not in the books (refused)
Pay a payout that is not recorded (refused)
Read a loan and its schedule
Pay out a loan that is not recorded (refused)
Cash and bank balances for a month

exec: pm.test('each balance is opening plus in minus out', () => pm.response.json().accounts.forEach((row) => pm.expect(row.balance).to.eql(row.opening + row.moneyIn - row.moneyOut)));

item.name: Ask to correct a voucher that is not recorded (refused)
Read an update request that does not exist
Approve an update request that does not exist
Reject an update request that does not exist
List what is waiting for approval

exec: pm.test('has both lists', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.waitingForYou.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.yoursWaiting.items).to.be.an('array'); });
